description.en: The largest and oldest Dutch technical university. Non-EU/EFTA bachelor students pay a fixed institutional fee. This card holds only the fee, not individual programmes.
description.ru: Крупнейший и старейший технический университет Нидерландов. Студенты не из ЕС/ЕАСТ платят фиксированную плату. В карточке только цена, без отдельных программ.

names.ru: Бакалаврские программы (плата для студентов не из ЕС)

notes_for_reviewer: Official tudelft.nl page read 2026-10-06: tuition for non-EU/EFTA bachelor students in 2026-2027 is EUR 19,906 per year; students who were already enrolled at the 2025-26 rate (EUR 17,310) pay a transitional EUR 18,175 (not stored). Non-EU first-year students who need help with a visa must pay by 1 July (23:59 CEST). THIS CARD IS GENERIC: the 16 BSc programmes are not listed, the length of 3 years is a general fact I did not verify on the page, and languages "en, nl" are my assumption (several programmes are Dutch-taught). Please treat it as an indication of price only. No ISCED-F code.
